DisciplineLeaderboardEntry.title: Discipline Leaderboard Entry
DisciplineLeaderboardEntry.description: Public snapshot of a warrior's discipline score, rank, and weekly completions on the community leaderboard.

userId.description: Unique identifier of the user (Firebase Auth UID or local warrior ID)

displayName.description: Display name or alias shown on the leaderboard

photoURL.description: Profile picture URL or avatar generator string

rankIndex.description: Numeric rank index (1 for Bronz up to 6 for Grandmaster)

rankName.description: Formatted rank title (e.g. Bronz, Argint, Maestru)

qualifyingWeeks.description: Number of qualifying discipline weeks completed

weeklyCompletedChecks.description: Number of completed habit check-ins for the week

weeklyTargetChecks.description: Total target check-ins possible for the week

topHabits.description: Top active discipline habits and completion percentages

isPublic.description: Whether the entry is visible on the public community leaderboard

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last progress update

DisciplineUserData.title: Discipline User Data
DisciplineUserData.description: Personal habit categories, daily check-ins, and user settings synced per user.

checks.description: Record mapping habit ID and day index to completion state

/discipline_leaderboard/{userId}.description: Public community discipline leaderboard entries indexed by user ID

/discipline_user_data/{userId}.description: Private warrior progress, habit categories, and check-ins indexed by user ID
